metadata.description: Likely represents a username or email address for accessing a site or system.

suggestions: Ensure this value is stored securely, e.g., in an encrypted secrets manager.
Use environment-specific variations (e.g., dev, staging, production).
Consider masking or obfuscating this value in logs or monitoring tools.

metadata.description: Represents the login provider or authentication method (e.g., Okta, SAML, OAuth).

suggestions: Validate the value against expected login types to prevent misconfiguration.
Document the supported authentication methods in application configuration.

metadata.description: Likely represents a password for accessing a site or system.
metadata.security_risk: Sensitive information that should never be exposed in plaintext.

suggestions: Store this value securely using an encrypted secrets manager.
Avoid hardcoding passwords in environment variables; use a vault solution instead.
Rotate passwords periodically to minimize security risks.
